title: Kimi Launches AI Solutions for the Financial Industry: One-Stop Access to More Than 10 Data Sources, Reducing Data Processing Time from Days to Hours
excerpt: Moonshot released the Kimi Financial Industry Solution. This solution provides one-stop access to more than 10 data sources, and includes 9 financial profession
content_html:
Moonshot released the Kimi Financial Industry Solution. This solution provides one-stop access to more than 10 data sources, and includes 9 financial professional skills and 5 security and compliance measures. It has the capability for institutional-level data modeling and report delivery.

The solution comprehensively covers core business scenarios such as portfolio morning reports, financial report comments, project screening, in-depth research, and portfolio reviews. It can compress the time required for document processing from days to hours, allowing professionals to focus on analysis and decision-making.
